[[File:Dario.png|thumb|250px|Dario in ''[[EP033|The Flame Pokémon-athon!]]'']] '''Dario''' (Japanese: '''ドリオ''' ''Dorio'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP033|The Flame Pokémon-athon!]]''. He also appeared in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]. ==In animation== Dario was an arrogant and rude {{pkmn|Trainer}} who presumably takes care of the Dodrio at the Pokemon Reserve. He went to great lengths to win the [[Big P Pokémon Race]]. He resorted to cheating, and hired {{TRT}} to stage a stampede that resulted in his rival competitor [[Lara Laramie]] breaking her arm. While she could not compete, {{Ash}} entered in her place, riding her {{p|Ponyta}}. Thanks to more of Team Rocket's assistance, Dario and his {{p|Dodrio}} quickly took the lead position during most of the race. Out of nowhere, Ash emerged and caught up to him. Dario had his Dodrio {{m|Peck}}ed at Ponyta, but it only delayed the Pokémon temporarily. It then [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Rapidash}} and defeated Dario by just a few centimeters. Dario hypocritically called Ash a cheater, even though ''he'' tried to cheat for the entire race, and attacked Rapidash. Enraged, Dario ordered Dodrio to attack Ash and Rapidash, but Rapidash kicked them with {{m|Stomp}} and sent them flying. Blaming Team Rocket for his loss, Dario tied them up and had his Dodrio use Peck on them. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Dario |pkmn=Dodrio |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Dario Dodrio.png |epnum=EP033 |epname=The Flame Pokémon-athon |desc=Dario's {{p|Dodrio}} appeared in ''[[EP033|The Flame Pokémon-athon]]'', where it competed in the [[Big P Pokémon Race]] event. Dodrio's long strides helped Dario stay in first for most of the race. Suddenly {{Ash}} and {{p|Ponyta}} caught up, so Dario tried to put Ponyta off balance with a Peck. Ponyta, however, [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Rapidash}} and won the race sending Dodrio flying with a {{m|Stomp}}. Dodrio's only known move is {{m|Peck}}.}} ===Pokémon competitions=== Dario has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Big P Pokémon Race]] - Runner-Up (''[[EP033|The Flame Pokémon-athon]]'') ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=結城比呂 ''Hiro Yūki'' |en=[[Maddie Blaustein|Maddie Blaustein]] |cs=Daniel Tůma |fi=Pasi Ruohonen |no=Erik Skøld |es_eu=Pablo Sevilla |es_la=Eduardo Garza |pl=Wojciech Majchrzak |pt_br=Vágner Fagundes |it=Paolo De Santis (K2 dub)}} ==In the manga== ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== [[File:Dario EToP.png|thumb|200px|Dario in The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] Dario appears in ''[[ET05|The Human Race and the Pokémon Race]]'', where he spooks Lara's Ponyta so that she will be injured and unable to participate in the [[Fuchsia Free-For-All Race]]. Unlike his animated series appearance, he spooks Ponyta by himself without Team Rocket's help. He also hired a bunch of thugs and a herd of {{p|Squirtle}}, {{p|Wartortle}} and {{p|Blastoise}} to help him cheat in the race. He was revealed to be a poor sport when Ash won, trying to take the flag away from him. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Dario's Pokémon in the manga: {{anchor|Dodrio 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Dario |pkmn=Dodrio |width=74 |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Dario Dodrio EToP.png |epnum=ET05 |epname=The Human Race and the Pokémon Race |desc={{p|Dodrio}} was used in the [[Fuchsia Free-For-All Race]].
